search.query: | mstats avg("amdgpu.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | 1=1 | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("amdgpu.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*vram_used*","*vram_total*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("amdgpu.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*busy_pct*","*temperature*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
